source_read: https://viewthe.menu/by8v (Autumn 2026 Menu Manchester and Sunday Main), downloaded afresh; read a second way through headless Chromium's DOM (popover text, per-serving table and the 14 allergen cells); re-run of the script on the fresh pages reproduces data/source
